summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Corporación América Airports S.A. reporting monthly passenger traffic data for June 2026. It details a 4.1% year-on-year decrease in total passenger traffic, with domestic traffic down 12.5% and international traffic up 2.8%. The report provides operational metrics but does not announce any merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation event. As a routine operational update by a foreign private issuer, it falls outside special-situations categories and is classified as 'None'.
